title: Site Safety Manager
description: Site Safety Manager (HSE) – Power Generation / EPC Location: Kirkuk, Iraq Employment Type: Full-Time | Renewable 12-Month Contract Rotation: 8 Weeks On / 2 Weeks Off (Expatriates) Salary: Negotiable Expected Start: January 2027 About the Company Our client is an international energy and infrastructure company specialising in Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) projects within the power generation sector. The company delivers large-scale energy infrastructure projects, including gas turbine power generation, combined-cycle power plant conversions, turbine inlet air cooling systems and power plant modernisation. Currently undertaking multiple major projects for Iraq's Ministry of Electricity, the company is converting existing simple-cycle power plants into more efficient combined-cycle facilities. With further projects planned, the organisation offers opportunities for experienced professionals to contribute to major infrastructure developments and potentially support future projects. About the Role We are seeking an experienced Site Safety Manager (HSE) to oversee all health, safety and environmental activities on a major combined-cycle power plant conversion project in Kirkuk, Iraq. The successful candidate will lead the site HSE function, manage subcontractor safety compliance and ensure safe construction and commissioning activities within an operational power plant. The position reports to the Project Manager, with a functional reporting line to the Head of HSE in the USA. Key Responsibilities Develop, implement and maintain the Project HSE Management Plan in accordance with ISO 45001, OSHA and Iraqi regulations. Oversee HSE compliance across construction, installation and commissioning activities. Manage safety procedures for brownfield operations, including PTW, SIMOPS, LOTO and plant shutdowns. Supervise high-risk activities including heavy lifting, working at height, confined spaces and electrical works. Lead the site HSE team and monitor subcontractor safety performance. Conduct safety inspections, audits, incident investigations and risk assessments. Prepare HSE performance reports and maintain compliance with project safety requirements. Manage safety training, emergency response procedures and evacuation preparedness. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering or a related field. Recognised HSE certification such as NEBOSH, IOSH or OSHA 30. 10+ years of HSE experience in major industrial or EPC construction projects. Minimum 5 years in an HSE management or leadership position. Strong experience in power generation, CCGT projects or heavy industrial construction preferred. Experience with brownfield construction, operational power plants, PTW, SIMOPS and shutdown safety. Proven experience managing HSE teams and multiple subcontractors. Strong knowledge of international HSE standards and safety management systems. Fluent English; Arabic or Kurdish advantageous. Previous experience in Iraq or the Middle East highly desirable. Employment Package Competitive, negotiable monthly salary. Renewable 12-month contract. 8 weeks on / 2 weeks off rotation for expatriates (paid). Company-provided economy flights, accommodation and meals. Medical, casualty and evacuation insurance. Security arrangements and visa costs covered. Potential opportunities across future power generation projects. Working Schedule: Saturday–Thursday, 10 hours daily for expatriates. Iraqi nationals work 8 hours daily. Apply Now If you are an experienced HSE Manager with a strong background in power generation, EPC construction or combined-cycle power plant projects, we encourage you to apply. Please submit your updated CV highlighting your relevant project experience, HSE leadership background and professional certifications.

title: Field Security Advisor
description: Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands. About the Role We have created a new standard in cyber extortion incident response and are expanding our Cyber Readiness & Advisory Services team to continue evolving the retained client experience. We are looking for a Field Security Advisor to help us develop and deliver valuable content, tabletop exercises, and training workshops to our enterprise customers. In this role, you will work closely with our Customer Success team and Field CISO organization to help Global 2000 customers prepare executive, technical, finance, legal, and operational teams for the realities of handling a cyber extortion incident and improving organizational resiliency. Coveware is a fully distributed company with employees across multiple geographies. This is a remote role with global time zone flexibility. Candidates may be based in any geography as long as they can provide reliable overlap with customer time zones and travel periodically for customer on-sites and events. This is an individual contributor role. The role reports to the Senior Director, Field CISO within the Cyber Readiness and Advisory Services team. Design and facilitate tabletop exercises that reflect realistic cyber extortion conditions, operational disruption, ambiguous early facts, and executive decision points. Curate and continuously improve customer-facing content, including playbooks, decision frameworks, readiness checklists, and workshop materials, keeping deliverables aligned to current ransomware/extortion patterns. Conduct research and forensic data analysis to support advisory deliverables and customer insights, including synthesizing lessons learned from case trends and interpreting forensic outputs/artifacts (as available) into clear, actionable readiness recommendations. Support the customer lifecycle as needed, including customer due diligence requests, RFP/RFI questionnaires, and review of contracts/security exhibits in partnership with internal stakeholders. Collaborate internally with case management, SMEs, and other stakeholders to ensure readiness guidance stays grounded in real-world incident behavior and recovery constraints. Foundational knowledge of application, identity, cloud and network security concepts, and incident response best practices, ideally in a Global 2000 enterprise environment. Demonstrated experience presenting in a consultative manner to enterprise leadership and facilitating educational workshops and tabletop exercises. Ability to communicate complex topics clearly and authoritatively to diverse audiences, orally and in writing. Willingness and ability to travel for customer meetings, workshops, and events on occasion. Comfortable leading discussions with enterprise stakeholders across both technical and executive teams. Consultative/advisory mindset with structured problem framing, strong facilitation skills, crisp communication, and defensible recommendations. Strong listening skills with excellent written and verbal communication skills and willingness to deliver hard truths when needed to surface gaps and drive improvement. Strong, structured writing skills with experience producing executive-ready, evidence-based deliverables, translating complex inputs into clear narratives, prioritized recommendations, and defensible documentation. Bonus Skills One or more information security certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CISA, CCSP, GCIH, GCFE, GCFA). Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field. Experience translating forensic findings and incident learnings into executive-ready narratives and prioritized readiness actions. Familiarity with frameworks/standards such as MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF and CIS Controls and how to apply them pragmatically to cyber defense and recovery. Experience collaborating with teammates to stay current on the threat landscape and continuously improve customer-facing materials. title: HSE Supervisor
description: INTECH Process Automation is seeking a skilled HSE Supervisor to join our Operations & Maintenance (O&M) team. The selected candidate will provide day-to-day HSE leadership at site, verifies that work is executed in accordance with approved HSE plans and procedures, identifies and controls hazards, monitors compliance with Permit to Work (PTW), LOTO and Job Safety Analysis/Risk Assessment requirements, and ensures timely reporting and close-out of unsafe conditions, incidents and nonconformances. ﻿Key Responsibilities: Provide day-to-day HSE leadership and field supervision for maintenance, project, shutdown, turnaround, and execution activities. Ensure compliance with COMPANY HSE procedures, legal requirements, PTW, LOTO, and approved work controls. Review and verify JSA/JHA, risk assessments, RAMS, method statements, and control measures, particularly for high-risk activities. Monitor and enforce safe execution of work at height, confined space, lifting, hot work, excavation, electrical work, pressure testing, chemical handling, SIMOPS, and energy isolation. Conduct regular site HSE inspections and audits, identify unsafe conditions and environmental issues, and ensure corrective actions are effectively closed. Conduct/support toolbox talks, safety briefings, HSE awareness activities, and workforce engagement. Respond to and support investigation of incidents, near misses, emergencies, and environmental events, including root-cause analysis and corrective actions. Support emergency preparedness, drills, response plans, and emergency equipment readiness. Monitor contractor and subcontractor HSE performance, including competency, documentation, PTW, PPE, LOTO, lifting, and other critical controls. Monitor environmental compliance, including waste management, chemical handling, spill prevention, housekeeping, and environmental incident reporting. Maintain accurate HSE reports, inspection/audit records, PTW records, incident reports, observations, training records, corrective-action registers, and HSE statistics. Identify recurring HSE risks and recommend preventive and continuous-improvement measures. Requirements: To Be Successful in This Role, You Must Have: Technical Degree/Dimploma in HSE, Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering, or related discipline, with a recognized HSE certification. Minimum 5 years of oil & gas experience, including at least 3 years as an HSE Supervisor or equivalent. Experience in maintenance, brownfield projects, shutdowns, turnarounds, or operating facilities preferred. Strong knowledge of HSE leadership, hazard identification, risk assessment, JSA/JHA, RAMS, PTW, LOTO, SIMOPS, and high-risk work controls. Experience in incident/near-miss investigation, root-cause analysis, emergency response, HSE inspections, audits, and corrective-action management. Competent in contractor HSE management, environmental controls, HSE reporting, statistics, and workforce engagement. Relevant certifications such as NEBOSH/IOSH, First Aid/CPR, Fire Fighting, Incident Investigation, PTW/LOTO, Confined Space, and Work at Height are preferred. Strong safety leadership, communication, decision-making, problem-solving, and reporting skills, with the confidence to challenge and stop unsafe work. Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary, multicultural teams and under operational/schedule pressure. Demonstrated commitment to COMPANY HSE requirements, continuous improvement, and proactive hazard prevention. ﻿We Offer Competitive Benefits: Global Exposure: Opportunities to work on international projects and collaborate with global teams. Competitive Compensation: A salary package that recognizes your expertise and contributions. Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical insurance for you and your dependents. Learning Opportunities: Access to training programs, workshops, and certifications to enhance your skills. Inclusive Environment: A workplace that celebrates diversity and fosters collaboration. As we continue to lead in the Industry 4.0 era, you will be at the forefront of transformative technologies that solve real-world challenges. ﻿What to Expect After Applying? title: Shift Operator
description: A Snapshot of your day Your day involves monitoring and controlling gas turbine operations in real time through DCS systems, conducting routine equipment inspections, and ensuring safe, efficient, and reliable power generation across the Khormala Power Plant. You play a key role in minimizing downtime by responding to operational needs, adhering to strict HSE standards, and maintaining the continuous performance of critical plant equipment. How You’ll Make An Impact Monitor and control gas turbine generators, auxiliary systems, and plant equipment through DCS to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient operations. Respond to alarms, investigate system abnormalities, and take corrective or emergency actions to maintain operational continuity. Conduct routine equipment inspections, identify faults or abnormalities, and support troubleshooting and maintenance activities. Safely isolate equipment and implement Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures while verifying plant readiness following maintenance work. Maintain full compliance with HSE standards and environmental regulations through safety inspections, hazard identification, incident reporting, and participation in safety programs. What You Bring Technical Diploma or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, Electrical, Control & Instrumentation Engineering, with 3-5 years of experience in power plant operations, preferably within gas turbine or combined cycle power plants. DCS Operator Certification and a recognized Health & Safety certification such as OSHA, NEBOSH, or equivalent. Strong expertise in Distributed Control Systems (DCS), gas turbine technology, auxiliary equipment, and Balance of Plant (BOP) systems. Proven knowledge of safety procedures including Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), hazard identification, risk assessment, and emergency response protocols. Excellent troubleshooting, root cause analysis, technical documentation, shift reporting, communication, and teamwork skills. About The Team Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo Our Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. title: HSE Supervisor (Water Injection Operations)
description: Monitor and ensure HSE compliance of all on-site water injection activities, including injection well operation, water source well operation, and injection facility operation Conduct routine HSE risk identification for water injection system operations (e.g., high-pressure water injection lines, injection pumps, chemical dosing/injection, water treatment facilities) Perform HSE inspections on water injection wellheads, injection manifolds, water source wells and associated surface facilities to identify leaks, pressure anomalies and equipment integrity issues Review and verify Permit-to-Work (PTW) and Job Safety Analysis (JSA) for water injection related operations such as well commissioning, acidizing, stimulation, profile control/water shut-off and well workover Supervise safe handling, storage and injection of chemicals used in water injection and water treatment processes Coordinate with WI Field Supervisor and relevant departments to ensure emergency preparedness for water injection system failures or abnormal events Requirements: Holder of NEBOSH / British Council Level-3 / NVQ Level-3 or equivalent qualification in HSE Minimum of five (5) years of relevant HSE experience within the field scope of work (water injection / oilfield operations preferred)
